rationale.consistency: Perfectly matches Zoekt idioms, cleanly integrates with the existing gitindex package and command structure.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles bare repos, worktrees, concurrent locking, directory traversal boundaries, and name collisions accurately.
rationale.scope: Implements exactly the requested subcommands and dry-run behavior; extracts index functions minimally without unrelated churn.
rationale.readability: Code is neatly factored into single-purpose files (discover, inventory, lock, main) with clear logic and naming.
rationale.robustness: Graceful error handling, correct non-blocking directory locks, and safe resource cleanup with defer.
rationale.maintainability: Highly extensible CLI structure using flag sets, separated logic, and reusable extracted index routines.
